chunks: From him, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Abdullah ibn Muskan, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Three are the closest of creation to Allah, Mighty and Majestic, on the Day of Judgment until the Reckoning is concluded: a man whose power does not invite him, in the state of his anger, to wrong those under his authority; and a man who mediates between two parties but does not incline with one against the other by even a barley seed; and a man who speaks the truth regarding what is for him and what is against him.

key_terms.بِشَعِيرَةٍ: By a barley seed (a small measure)

ai.seo_question: Who are the three types of people closest to Allah on the Day of Judgment according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni highlights these three archetypes to illustrate the practical application of justice (adl) in personal conduct and social relations. The first emphasizes restraint of power by leaders, the second underscores impartiality in mediation, and the third focuses on intellectual honesty in recognizing one's own rights and duties. This triad reflects the Shia emphasis on balancing internal self-discipline with external social equity.

en.hubeali:
Rom him, from Usman Bin Isa, from Abdullah Bin Muskan, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Three (types), they would be the closest of the people to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic on the Day of Judgement until He<sup>azwj</sup> is Free from the Reckoning – a man whose power does not invite him, during the state of his anger, to wrong the one who in under his hand; and a man who walks (mediates) between two, but he does not incline with one of them against the other with (even) a barley seed; and a man who speaks with the truth in what is for him, and (what is) against him’.
en.sarwar: 5. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from ‘Abd Allah ibn Muskan from Muhammad ibn Muslim from abu ‘Abd Allah Who has said the following:

“Three people of all creatures will be the closest to Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, on the Day of Judgment until all accounting is finished: a man whose power does not lead him in anger to do injustice to his subjects, a man who mediates between two people and does not lean toward anyone of them even to the size of a grain of bailey (needle’s head), and a man who speaks the truth regardless, it is for or against his own self.”
